create_embedding_lookup: create an embedding lookup layer from token ids with configurable lookup style and scaling
build_vision_transformer: build a vision transformer model with configurable layers, heads, dropout, and normalization policy
build_factorized_video_encoder: build a factorized space-time video encoder that processes video tensors into embeddings
build_video_clip_model: build a video-text contrastive model with factorized vision encoder and causal text encoder
build_video_classifier: build a video classifier with factorized encoder backbone and attention pooling for classification
